sources.provider: NASA GES DISC Earthdata GPM_3IMERGHH v07

readiness.reason: at least one complete 48-slot UTC day
NDVI/EVI QA observations; no crop identification
regional SMAP L4; not parcel measurement
parameter file exists but WOFOST calibration is NOT certified
regional prices alone do not equal net farm profit
NSGA/Pareto model is separate future milestone

blockers.weather_pcse_adapter: VAP, E0, ES0, ET0 and unit conversions need a versioned PCSE adapter
blockers.crop_variety: validated PCSE crop/variety parameter set absent
blockers.site_parameters: PCSE compatible site parameters/initial conditions absent
blockers.agromanagement: prospective sowing/emergence/harvest calendar and management absent
blockers.soil_hydraulics: required for WLP: validated hydraulics, rooting depth and initial water
blockers.observed_calibration: independent growth/yield observations missing; simulations unvalidated

notes: Source availability and PCSE simulation readiness are distinct gates
GPM covers only the requested UTC day; SMAP covers a short snapshot
No observed farm acreage or crop variety; the 1ha schema field is synthetic
Crop, site, soil and management parameters require explicit evidence
limitations: Decision support prototype; not field-validated crop advice
Coarse-grained satellite/model data do not measure individual fields
No missing crop parameters, farmer costs or market prices are silently imputed
A generated profile is NOT a WOFOST/NSGA result
Intercropping supported by input schema, but NOT simulated or certified by this builder
